name: Spring (Hooke's law)
description: Hooke's-law loading experiment: hang a known mass on a spring and measure its extension. The weight force is force_N = (mass_g / 1000) × 9.81. Regress force_N vs extension_m and the slope is the spring constant k ≈ 19.6 N/m (a straight line through the origin confirms F = kx). Idealised values for a first look at the law.

columns.name: force_N
columns.description: Weight force on the spring in newtons (mass × g)

columns.name: extension_m
columns.description: Spring extension from its natural length, in metres
